anchor: The 672^2 margin on the faster fabric is thin and reflects the single-stream handoff assumption, and on the sustained 24-hour window 672^2 misses the bound on both fabrics --- so that fabric margin is a burst-window result and must never be quoted without its window.
claim_text: 672^2 margin thin on faster fabric (single-stream handoff assumption); on 24h window 672^2 misses bound on both fabrics; margin is burst-window result only.

adjudication.observed: On steady24h, fcAware and static_C8 on g100 pass (p99 of 842.492ms is under the 1000ms bound), while fc_L30 (1927.455ms) and fc_L30_cap28 (1943.981ms) miss the bound on both fabrics.
adjudication.evidence: On the sustained 24-hour window, 672^2 meets the 1000ms encoder-delay p99 bound on the faster fabric (g100) under fcAware and static_C8 policies (842.492ms), contradicting the unqualified claim of missing on both fabrics.
adjudication.fix: Qualify the claim to specify that on the 24-hour window, 672^2 misses the bound on both fabrics under the standard/non-aware forecast policy (fc_L30 and fc_L30_cap28), as the forecast-aware policy (fcAware) still meets the bound on the faster fabric.
adjudication.query: SELECT run_id, window_name, p99_ms FROM provenance.v_pool_latency WHERE is_current = true AND experiment = 'g6' AND run_id LIKE 'g6:u672__steady24h%' ORDER BY run_id;

adjudication.observed: On steady24h, fcAware g100 has p99_ms=842.492 against bound_ms=1000 and therefore misses_bound=false, while fcAware g25 has p99_ms=1012.432 and misses; fc_L30 and fc_L30_cap28 miss on both fabrics. All rows are current, superseded_by is null, and deployable_static_c8 denominator_window matches with denominator_window_mismatch=false.
adjudication.evidence: The both-fabrics result holds only for the forecast variants; fcAware 672^2 meets the steady24h bound on g100, and the views expose handoff parameters but do not establish the claimed single-stream causal attribution.
adjudication.fix: Name the forecast variant explicitly: fc_L30 and fc_L30_cap28 miss the steady24h bound on both fabrics; do not generalize this to every 672^2 run, and remove or separately substantiate the single-stream causal attribution.
adjudication.query: WITH latency AS (SELECT l.run_id,l.window_name,d.window_span_s,d.window_requests,CASE WHEN l.run_id LIKE '%__g100' THEN 'g100' ELSE 'g25' END AS fabric,split_part(l.run_id,'__',3) AS variant,l.sla_metric,l.p99_ms,l.n_requests,l.queue_divergent,d.superseded_by FROM provenance.v_pool_latency l JOIN provenance.v_dim d USING(run_id) WHERE l.is_current=true AND d.is_current=true AND l.experiment='g6' AND l.run_id LIKE 'g6:u672%' AND split_part(l.run_id,'__',3) IN ('fcAware','fc_L30','fc_L30_cap28')), cost AS (SELECT run_id,cost_ratio,denominator_kind,denominator_worker_seconds,denominator_workers,denominator_window,denominator_window_mismatch FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio WHERE is_current=true AND experiment='g6' AND run_id LIKE 'g6:u672%' AND denominator_kind='deployable_static_c8') SELECT l.window_name,l.window_span_s,l.window_requests,l.fabric,l.variant,l.p99_ms,b.bound_ms,(l.p99_ms>b.bound_ms) AS misses_bound,l.n_requests,l.queue_divergent,l.superseded_by,f.handoff_gbps,f.handoff_rtt_ms,f.handoff_p99_ms,f.handoff_alone_violates_sla,c.cost_ratio,c.denominator_kind,c.denominator_worker_seconds,c.denominator_workers,c.denominator_window,c.denominator_window_mismatch FROM latency l JOIN provenance.v_sla_bound b USING(sla_metric) JOIN provenance.v_fabric_sensitivity f USING(run_id) LEFT JOIN cost c USING(run_id) ORDER BY l.window_name,l.fabric,l.variant
